zh: 线程不会过期，也没有时间窗口：任何时刻能否服务一个请求，只取决于此前累计新增的线程数减去已经成功处理的请求数。
按顺序模拟并维护当前可用线程数：正数事件增加可用线程，请求到来时有可用线程就消耗一个，否则这个请求被丢弃。
可用数和丢弃数都从 0 开始；遍历事件：值大于 0 时可用数加上该值；值为 −1 时若可用数大于 0 则减 1，否则丢弃数加 1；最后输出丢弃数。
en: Threads never expire and there is no time window: whether a request is served depends only on the threads added so far minus the requests already served.
Simulate in order with a count of available threads: a positive event adds threads, and a request consumes one thread if any is available, otherwise it is dropped.

Start with zero available threads and zero drops; for each event, a positive value adds to the available count, and a −1 decrements the available count if it is positive or otherwise increments the drop count; print the drop count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Track the number of available threads in order; when a request arrives, decrement it if a thread is available, otherwise count a drop.

## Proof of correctness

After processing any prefix, the available count is exactly the threads added minus the successful requests; deciding whether the next request succeeds by whether this count is zero matches the original rule exactly, so by induction the drop count is correct.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) space apart from the input.
